interface Options {
  verbose?: boolean;
  depth?: number;
}

interface Point {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

function run(options: Options & { id: number }): string {
  return `run ${options.id} verbose=${options.verbose ?? false} depth=${options.depth ?? 1}`;
}

console.log(run({ id: 1 }));
console.log(run({ id: 2, depth: 3 }));

const partial: Partial<Point> & { name: string } = { name: "origin" };
console.log(partial.name, partial.x ?? 0);

const extra = { name: "named", other: true };
const named: { x?: number } & { name: string } = extra;
console.log(named.name);

const bothWeak: { x?: number } & { y?: number } = { y: 2 };
console.log(bothWeak.y);

const labelled: Options & { label?: string } = { label: "only label" };
console.log(labelled.label);

const either: (Options & { id: number }) | string = { id: 4 };
console.log(typeof either === "string" ? either : either.id);

function withDefaults<T extends object>(value: T, overrides: Partial<T> & { tag: string }): T & { tag: string } {
  return { ...value, ...overrides };
}

console.log(withDefaults({ x: 1, y: 2 }, { tag: "moved", y: 5 }));
